color.note: Winter field palette. Neutrals carry a faint spruce bias; five muted hues each mean exactly one thing. Ochre is reserved for the operator.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background, the snowfield. Every view starts here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels, popovers and the command palette. One step lighter than ground in light, one step lighter in dark too.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, code, the event stream gutter, Kbd and Ref chips. Below ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around panels. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, quiet buttons, segmented controls) and chart axes. Holds 3:1 on ground, surface and sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary button fill. 13:1 or better on ground, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sentences that describe what an agent is doing, panel body copy. 6.8:1 or better on every ground and every -soft fill.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: metadata, timestamps, counters, axis labels, the quiet state. 4.5:1 or better on ground, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: The lit window. Means one thing: you. Needs-you glyphs, the focus ring, the primary attention count. As text, on ground, surface, sunken or ochre-soft.

tokens.name: ochre-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a needs-you row or chip, behind ochre or ink-2 text. Text selection.

tokens.name: on-ochre
tokens.usage: Text on a solid ochre fill (the attention count badge).

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Broken: failed units, 5xx probes, invocation failures, dead letters. As text, on any ground or brick-soft.

tokens.name: brick-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind brick text in a broken row or chip.

tokens.name: heather
tokens.usage: Stuck: over its time budget, a lease with no worker, a heartbeat that stopped. Derived from time, never from an error. As text, on any ground or heather-soft.

tokens.name: heather-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind heather text.

tokens.name: lake
tokens.usage: Working: a live agent, a running tool, a feed that is moving. As text, on any ground or lake-soft.

tokens.name: lake-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind lake text; the in-progress phase of a lifecycle track.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Cleared: left the queue recently (shipped, closed, recovered). Earned, not ambient. Healthy-and-boring is ink-3, not moss.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind moss text.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wash laid over any surface. Rows, quiet buttons, census cells.

tokens.name: signal-you
tokens.usage: Semantic alias for ochre. Use in components so the meaning travels with the token.

tokens.name: signal-broken
tokens.usage: Semantic alias for brick.

tokens.name: signal-stuck
tokens.usage: Semantic alias for heather.

tokens.name: signal-working
tokens.usage: Semantic alias for lake.

tokens.name: signal-cleared
tokens.usage: Semantic alias for moss.

tokens.name: signal-quiet
tokens.usage: Semantic alias for ink-3. Idle, healthy, nothing to say.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour. Your hand is ochre too. 3:1 or better on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical chart slot 1 (slate). Assign in order, never cycled; validated as an adjacent set (CVD ΔE ≥ 12.8, normal ΔE ≥ 18.8) in both themes. Marks only; labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical chart slot 2 (clay). Assign in order, never cycled; validated as an adjacent set (CVD ΔE ≥ 12.8, normal ΔE ≥ 18.8) in both themes. Marks only; labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Categorical chart slot 3 (teal). Assign in order, never cycled; validated as an adjacent set (CVD ΔE ≥ 12.8, normal ΔE ≥ 18.8) in both themes. Marks only; labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Categorical chart slot 4 (sand). Assign in order, never cycled; validated as an adjacent set (CVD ΔE ≥ 12.8, normal ΔE ≥ 18.8) in both themes. Marks only; labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Categorical chart slot 5 (plum). Assign in order, never cycled; validated as an adjacent set (CVD ΔE ≥ 12.8, normal ΔE ≥ 18.8) in both themes. Marks only; labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Categorical chart slot 6 (lichen). Assign in order, never cycled; validated as an adjacent set (CVD ΔE ≥ 12.8, normal ΔE ≥ 18.8) in both themes. Marks only; labels stay in ink tokens.

tokens.name: ramp-1
tokens.usage: One-hue lake ramp for magnitude, step 1 (least): heatmap cells, density. Step 1 sits nearest the ground in both themes and still holds 2:1; validated monotone with adjacent ΔL ≥ 0.06.

tokens.name: ramp-2
tokens.usage: One-hue lake ramp for magnitude, step 2 (low): heatmap cells, density. Step 1 sits nearest the ground in both themes and still holds 2:1; validated monotone with adjacent ΔL ≥ 0.06.

tokens.name: ramp-3
tokens.usage: One-hue lake ramp for magnitude, step 3 (high): heatmap cells, density. Step 1 sits nearest the ground in both themes and still holds 2:1; validated monotone with adjacent ΔL ≥ 0.06.

tokens.name: ramp-4
tokens.usage: One-hue lake ramp for magnitude, step 4 (most): heatmap cells, density. Step 1 sits nearest the ground in both themes and still holds 2:1; validated monotone with adjacent ΔL ≥ 0.06.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines: hairline, solid, recessive.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Statements
groups.note: Newsreader, used with restraint: one statement per view. Never for numbers, labels or anything in a row.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one sentence at the top of a view that answers its question.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles in the nav-less phone and car layouts; section titles in docs.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Empty states and receipts. Italic, always a full sentence with a period.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next. 14px is the base; the UI is dense on purpose.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel headings, the name in an agent line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: PM is reconciling the ticket board, evidence, and worker state.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: codex is waiting on a permission prompt

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines under a row title, tooltips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels and chart legends. Set the text in sentence case and let CSS uppercase it.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A reading’s value. Proportional figures; one per reading.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono with tabular figures. Everything a machine wrote: IDs, subjects, SHAs, durations in rows.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Timestamps, durations, counters and refs inside rows.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: The ref that names a row.

spacing.note: 4px grid, named by pixel value so the name is the number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-glyph, the surface gap between chart segments.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a row title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between chips.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row padding (block), between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding, row padding (inline).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between panels.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between sections of a view.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Page top margin under the statement.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Around an empty-state receipt.

radius.note: Instruments, not toys: corners barely soften. Only glyph dots go round.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Kbd, Ref chips, census cells, chart data-ends.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Panels, popovers, the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Count badges and the cleared glyph.

shadow.note: Layering is done with lightness and hairlines. Shadows exist only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, tooltips, the command palette, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground-coloured gap, then 2px of solid ochre. Applied as box-shadow so it follows the radius. Never removed without a replacement.

size.note: Control and row heights. Dense by default; touch layouts step up one size.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Row actions, chips that act, the segmented control in a panel header.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Phone (/hq) and touch layouts.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a one-line list row (agent line, event row).

tokens.name: glyph
tokens.usage: Signal glyph box at body size; 8px in data rows.

duration.note: Motion confirms, it never decorates. Everything respects prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, press, copy confirmation.

tokens.name: duration-calm
tokens.usage: Popovers, row insertion in a live list.

tokens.name: duration-armed
tokens.usage: How long a two-step destructive button stays armed.

tokens.name: duration-orbit
tokens.usage: One turn of the working glyph. Slow on purpose: alive, not anxious.

easing.note: One curve for everything that moves.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Enter, expand, settle. Exits use the same curve at duration-quick.
